qa.title: Q2395 (Sep. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If an infinite loop is possible when multiple cards are played in combination, how is it resolved? Also, can this process be shortened?
qa.answer:
Follow these steps to resolve infinite loops quickly:
1. The turn player explains the loop and gets permission from their opponents to shorten the resolution.
2. The turn player states how many times they will perform the loop or what the end result will be.
3. The game state is adjusted to match the result after the number of loops or end result mentioned above.
4. After performing this procedure, you may not repeat the same sequence of actions if doing so would result in a game state that is completely identical; you must take a different action.

However, if a non-turn player can use a Quick card or ability, they can state where they would like to alter the procedure. In that case, step 3 above would stop at the point the procedure is altered.
